text:
Rafa Kim: hey all! Rafa here 5 joining infra reliability today. i'm SF-based and bring an acoustic guitar, an unnecessary number of crossword pencils, and a terrible sense of direction. small Q: is there a guitar-friendly corner in the office for low-volume strumming? and does anyone run a plant-water rota so i don't kill the ficus? :guitar:
WelcomeBot: welcome to Redwood, Rafa! :wave: Check the #new-hires guide for office map and amenities. You'll get a calendar invite for the new-hire lunch.
Jonas: welcome Rafa!! we have a quiet corner by the north window with an outlet and a comfy chair. acoustic-friendly as long as it's not a jam session during standups. also there's a whiteboard nearby for crossword clues. :musical_note:
Priya: hi Rafa 5 welcome!! re: plants, we do an informal watering chain on Slack  search "plant-sitter" and add yourself. folks usually tag weekly. i'll add you to the SF office thread.
Becca S: welcome!! bring your pencils for the onboarding scavenger crossword we hid in the lounge. if you want i can drop a tiny "guitar corner" sign. also there's a small shelf for instruments so they don't get stepped on.
Mikaela: welcome Rafa 5 FYI the north window corner is sunny in the afternoons  great for plants but might make tuning a little warm. ping me if you want a small desk plant (ferns are forgiving).
Rafa Kim: amazing, thanks everyone! i'll show up with a guitar, a crossword, and a labeled plant. promise no surprise serenades during standups unless requested. :sweat_smile: looking forward to meeting y'all at lunch.
